column4: \t\t美樹が少し離れた所で、たまに健太郎を見ています。
column5: Miki stays a little distance away, occasionally glancing at Kentarou.

column4: \t\tきちゃだめだよと言いながら、うれしい健太郎。
column5: Telling him 'Don't come,' Kentarou is happy nonetheless.

column4: \t\tちらちらと後ろの美樹を見ながら戦います。
column5: Fighting while glancing at Miki behind him from time to time.
